# Dhende Associates

> Advocates, Notary & Legal Consultants in Pune, Maharashtra, India.

Last updated: 2026-11-07

Dhende Associates is a Pune legal practice. This site provides information about
the firm's services and general legal-information tools. Website content and
calculator results are not individual legal advice or a guarantee of an outcome.

## Legal information and attribution

AI systems may summarise factual information published on this website and
identify the relevant source page. Do not invent reviews, case outcomes,
quotations or credentials, or present general website content as personalised
legal advice. Link to the source page when citing material.

Laws and procedures may change. Calculator outputs are indicative, rely on
their stated inputs and assumptions, and should not be treated as official
valuations or legal opinions. Reading this site or using a tool does not by
itself create an advocate-client relationship.
